segments.name: Space-based intelligence
segments.description: Provides space-based intelligence products and services to U.S. and international government agencies and commercial customers through imagery, analytics, custom satellites and technology programs.
segments.evidence: Accordingly, for the years ended December 31, 2025 and 2024, the Company was deemed to be comprised of only one operating segment and one reportable segment.

revenueModel.text: Customers, primarily domestic and international government agencies, pay for space-based intelligence and AI services, mission solutions and advanced technology programs.
revenueModel.evidence: The Company generates revenue from the sale of space-based intelligence & AI services, mission solutions, and advanced technology programs, primarily to domestic and international government agencies.

changes.text: In 2025 the Company reclassified its statement of operations captions to align with its growing mission solutions and advanced technology programs offerings.
changes.evidence: Effective January 1, 2025, the Company reclassified its captions on the consolidated statements of operations and comprehensive loss to better align with the Company's increasing portfolio of mission solutions product offerings and advanced technology program service offerings.
